description: Get Amazon product data by ASIN via Scrapingdog — title, price, rating, review count, availability, feature bullets, and images as parsed JSON. Pass an asin (e.g. "B0BFC7WQ6R") or a full Amazon product url. Example: scrapingdog_amazon_product({ asin: "B0BFC7WQ6R", domain: "com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: BYOK Scrapingdog API key (free trial at scrapingdog.com)

asin.description: Amazon ASIN (product identifier), e.g. "B0BFC7WQ6R". Provide this or `url`.

country.description: ISO country code for marketplace targeting, e.g. "us". Default "us" (1 credit; other countries cost 5).

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for product data, e.g. "en", "de". Optional.

url.description: Full Amazon product URL — the ASIN is extracted from it. Alternative to `asin`.

name: scrapingdog_amazon_product
title: Scrapingdog Amazon Product
